name: imf_get_country_profile
description:
Macro snapshot of one country from the IMF World Economic Outlook in one request: GDP growth, inflation (average), unemployment, current account (% of GDP) and general government gross debt (% of GDP), for the last five years and this one. Values after latest_actual_year are IMF projections.
Returns: country_code, country_name, indicators (per name: code, name, latest_value, latest_period, latest_actual_year, recent_data of the last three periods; or an error), source, note.
Inputs (* required): country_code* (ISO3 or ISO2).
For longer history use imf_get_weo_data.
Example: {"country_code": "BRA"}

country_code.description: Country: ISO alpha-3 (USA) or alpha-2 (US); IMF group codes such as G001 (world) pass through

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Get a comprehensive economic snapshot for any country with key macroeconomic indicators.
